_reference: Real wrapped Pod tensor-record envelope + per-tensor body shapes, for MemorySearch Phase-1 fixtures. Provided by Claude from the live CP-1003-GABE DataQuad and core/dataquad/records.py, 2026-07-25. Purpose: keep memorysearch-*.json fixtures faithful to the ACTUAL on-disk record shape so Phase-1 search/scoring logic transfers to real records instead of passing locally against a simplified stub.

_provenance.body_field_names: core/dataquad/records.py (BaseRecord + PEERRecord/PCTRecord/NCTRecord/SPINERecord Pydantic models) and the live record body observed above.
_provenance.wrapping: core/dataquad/pod.py wrap()/unwrap(); read_records() returns the UNWRAPPED body (model_validate of _pod.unwrap(line)). Search may operate on either the wrapped envelope or the unwrapped body — fixtures should carry the wrapped form so both paths are exercised.

body.distilled_summary: NCT is the Nostalgic Context Tensor: condensed, symbolic long-term memory reduced to markers, lessons, or signatures. Stores relics, not narratives.

example_NCT_record_defining_nostalgic_co._note: NCT body fields (distilled_summary, essence_memory, pivots, source_record_ids) per NCTRecord in records.py. The canonical phrase 'Nostalgic Context Tensor' appears in distilled_summary AND essence_memory — a match-confidence 'exact canonical phrase match' + 'defining-language indicator (is/means)' should score this as the defining record.

working_context.definition: PCT is the Persistent Context Tensor: active, working memory, referenced frequently, mutable only by accretion (append-only).

example_PCT_record_defining_persistent_c._note: PCT body fields (working_context, retrieved_record_ids, rls_session_id, pressure_state) per PCTRecord. Real-world PCT records can be large because retrieved_record_ids embeds selected IDs — fixtures should include at least one bulky PCT to exercise scoring on realistic sizes.

body.pattern: Canon 7.2 Contextual Tensors: PCT = Persistent Context Tensor (working memory); NCT = Nostalgic Context Tensor (condensed symbolic memory, relics not narratives).

example_SPINE_record_canon_anchor._note: SPINE body fields (pattern, invariant, relationships, source_record_ids, nature_aspect_refs) per SPINERecord. invariant=true records are the identity/axiom/canon anchors; a Canon-definition claim class should prefer SPINE + NCT scope. This anchor is the strongest verified-retrieval hit for 'what is NCT according to the Canon'.

example_negative_no_ZCT_record._note: For the ZCT negative demo (proposal section 9): include ONLY records like the above (NCT/PCT/SPINE) plus unrelated records with weak lexical overlap on 'C'/'Tensor', and NO record whose defining-language field defines 'ZCT'. Correct behavior: search runs, no qualifying record clears the confidence threshold, grounding_status = search_performed_no_verified_record. There is deliberately no ZCT record here.
